categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily engages in the research, production, and sales of nonwoven fabrics, chemical fibers, and nonwoven fabric products. Its product portfolio includes spunlace nonwoven materials, hot air nonwoven fabrics, long filament superfine fiber nonwoven fabrics, meltblown nonwoven fabrics, degradable nonwoven fabrics, and ES composite short fibers. These products serve hygiene materials, decoration, industrial materials, and medical sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced technologies such as spunlace, hot air, meltblown, and wet-laid processes for nonwoven fabric production. It has proprietary equipment technology with customized production lines optimized for product quality and efficiency. The firm emphasizes R&D in fiber composition, production processes, and environmentally friendly degradable materials, including wet-laid technology for degradable nonwoven fabrics.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include manufacturers in hygiene products (e.g., wet wipes, masks, sanitary napkins), medical supplies, decoration (synthetic leather, automotive interiors), and industrial materials (construction, filtration). The company serves both domestic and international markets, with exports primarily to Japan, South Korea, and expanding into Europe and the Americas.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with headquarters and production facilities in Anhui Province. It serves domestic markets extensively and exports products to East Asia (Japan, South Korea) and is actively expanding into European and American markets.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company is positioned in the midstream of the nonwoven fabric industry supply chain, focusing on manufacturing nonwoven materials from raw fibers. Upstream suppliers provide raw materials like polyester staple fiber, viscose staple fiber, and polypropylene, while downstream customers engage in further processing into hygiene, medical, decorative, and industrial products.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include enhancing product quality, expanding high-end and differentiated nonwoven fabric products, and green transformation via degradable materials. The company invests significantly in R&D to innovate production equipment, optimize processes, and develop new fiber composites. Key R&D projects focus on improving uniformity, energy efficiency, waste reduction, and customized product patterns.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of nonwoven fabric products and chemical fibers to industrial customers. The company employs a direct sales model supplemented by selective distribution partnerships, with sales recognized upon customer acceptance and delivery. It also earns investment income from financial assets and engages in hedging activities to stabilize raw material costs.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic nonwoven fabric manufacturer with strong scale, technical capabilities, and brand recognition ('Jinchun'). It competes with other specialized nonwoven fabric producers in China and maintains a competitive edge through technology innovation, product diversification, and stable customer relationships. It is recognized as a top ten enterprise in the Chinese nonwoven fabric industry.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, a 14.65% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 30.9 million, up 2.2%. The company has steadily increased production capacity and sales volume, with a capacity utilization rate around 90%. R&D expenses accounted for about 3.19% of revenue, reflecting ongoing investment in innovation.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, customized nonwoven fabric solutions with advanced production technology and environmentally friendly degradable products. Its proprietary equipment and process innovations enable differentiated products with superior performance in hygiene, medical, and industrial applications. The 'Jinchun' brand is well-regarded for reliability, product variety, and timely supply, supporting long-term customer partnerships.
